statement_en:
If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution of $1$ with another arithmetic function $g$, that is, $$f=1*g,$$ and if:
1. $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges conditionally,
2. $$\sum_{n\leq x}|g(n)|=O(x),$$
then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ exists and equals the sum of that series, namely $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
callout_body:
如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$如果：
1. $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$条件收敛
2. $\sum_{n\leq x}|g(n)|=O(x)$

那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$
